company.shortDescription: Unrivaled is a women’s basketball league that provides an off-season platform for elite athletes to play.
company.description: Unrivaled is a women’s professional three-on-three basketball league that provides an off-season platform for elite athletes to play domestically. It features six teams, each composed of six top players, competing under a shortened-court, fast-paced format with a unique “winning score” fourth period and modified free-throw rules. Players receive six-figure salaries and equity in the league, and amenities are provided, including housing, training, and lifestyle support.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $106,346,952, or 70.86% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $28,666,644 to $650,000,000, a 22.67x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 73 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 87 (+33).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
